description: Six to Ten of Wands in tarot: upright and reversed meanings, from recognition and resilience to overload, plus how to read them in a tarot spread.
lede: The Six to Ten of Wands follow the fire suit from recognition to overload. Each card has an upright and a reversed meaning.

faces.alt: Five original gold-linework tarot card faces in a row, in order: Six of Wands, Seven of Wands, Eight of Wands, Nine of Wands and Ten of Wands. Each shows its number and a wand icon with the card name beneath. No scenes are drawn.
faces.caption: Six to Ten of Wands in order, shown as simple number-and-suit card faces.
